exams.title: Anveshana DSA Challenge
exams.description: Central University Club annual competitive algorithmic and data structures assessment.

questions.title: Two Sum
questions.description:
Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.

You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice. You can return the answer in any order.

questions.title: Reverse Array
questions.description:
Given an array of `n` integers, reverse the array in-place and print the elements separated by space.

### Input Format
First line contains integer `n`.
Second line contains `n` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
Print the reversed array separated by single space.

questions.title: Linked List Cycle
questions.description: Given a representation of a linked list with `n` nodes and a position `pos` where the tail connects to (-1 if no cycle), determine if there is a cycle. Print "true" or "false".

questions.title: Binary Search
questions.description: Given a sorted array of `n` distinct integers and a `target` value, return the index if target is found. If not, return -1.

questions.title: Stack Implementation
questions.description: Implement a basic min-stack operations processor: push X, pop, top, getMin.
